headline: Set public hearing for June 1, 2026, on naming road into Beverly Golf & Tennis "Matzeliger Way."
summary: The City Council took up Order #061, a request to start the process of naming the road into Beverly Golf & Tennis as "Matzeliger Way" in honor of Jan Ernst Matzeliger. The council voted to schedule a public hearing on the matter for June 1, 2026, at 7:30 PM.
decisions: Set a public hearing for June 1, 2026, at 7:30 PM on naming the road into Beverly Golf & Tennis as "Matzeliger Way," as recommended by the subcommittee; motion carried 7-0.

# City of Beverly
# Special City Council Meeting
# Public Meeting Minutes
# Wednesday, April 29, 2026, 7:00 PM
# Remote Meeting on Google Meet

Julie Flowers, City Council President, called the meeting to order at 6:01 PM. Assistant City Clerk, Sarah Kirker, took attendance by roll call.

Members Present: Julie Flowers, Steven Crowley, Kathleen Feldman, Scott Houseman, Todd Rotondo, Keith Sonia, Danielle Spang.

Members Absent: Matthew St. Hilaire, John Mullady.

Also Present:

Recorded by: Sarah Kirker

## Unfinished Business from a previous meeting:

**Order #061**-Councilor Rotondo-A request to initiate the process to name the road leading into Beverly Golf & Tennis as "Matzeliger Way" in honor of Jan Ernst Matzeliger.

A motion to set a public hearing for June 1, 2026, at 7:30 PM as recommended by the subcommittee was made and seconded. A roll call vote was taken, and motion carried (7-0).

A motion to adjourn was made and seconded. A roll call vote was taken, and motion carried (7-0). The meeting adjourned at 6:06 PM.
